newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary parliament greets NATO invite.
newsitem.headline: Hungary parliament greets NATO invite.

text.p: Hungary's parliament unanimously passed on Tuesday a motion welcoming the decision by the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation last week to invite Hungary into the first group of new members.
In an almost unprecedented show of unity between government and opposition parties the house passed the motion with 312 votes for, none against and no abstentions.

A NATO summit in Madrid last week invited Hungary, Poland and the Czech Republic to become the first new members of an expanded alliance and reassured Slovenia, Romania and the Baltic States that they would be considered seriously in future expansions.
